subject: POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed kickoff plan for the POC so we’re aligned on scope, success metrics, owners, and access steps. Please confirm or call out any changes.

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: Search & knowledge retrieval is returning stale, low-relevance results for product docs and support tickets; high deflection failures for technical KB content.
- Goal: Improve relevant retrieval for top-50 KB queries and reduce time-to-answer for support agents (target: 30% reduction in avg handle time for covered flows).

POC scope (4 weeks)
- Data: Ingest product docs + last 6 months of support tickets (subset: top categories).
- Model & infra: Redwood hosted inference using Mistral-7B-v2 quantized variant for initial eval; ability to switch to a larger model for quality stage.
- Integrations: Search reranker + agent assist prototype (web UI demo).
- Deliverables: weekly syncs, prompt set & eval results, final recommendations + cost/latency report.

Success metrics (examples)
- Retrieval precision@10 on curated eval set (target: >= 0.75)
- Avg token latency for responses (SLO: < 350ms median)
- Agent handle time reduction (target: >= 30% for scoped flows)
- Model cost per 1k queries (baseline + projected savings with batching/quantization)

Owners & roles
- Acme: Jane Doe (product lead) — data access & evaluation sign-off, Tom Patel (procurement) — contracting.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — POC PM & customer success, Rishi Malhotra — technical lead (model config & infra), Aditya Rao — solutions engineer (integration + prompt tuning).

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): SOW signed, data access granted, onboarding call.
- Week 1: Data ingestion & initial index + baseline eval.
- Week 2: Prompt tuning & reranker integration, interim eval.
- Week 3: Performance tuning & latency/cost optimization.
- Week 4: Final eval, handoff, and recommended rollout plan.

Access & setup steps we need from Acme
1) S3 share or secure transfer of product docs + support ticket export (instructions attached).
2) Service account / API key for internal sandbox search endpoint (read-only).
3) Whitelisted IPs or VPN instructions if you want Private deployment access.

Attachments included:
- acme-poc-sow.pdf — proposed SOW & pricing (draft)
- acme-poc-prompt-set.csv — initial eval prompt set (sample)
- redwood-access-instructions.md — step-by-step for data transfer & IAM roles

Next steps / asks
- Jane: confirm scope & success metrics and share data delivery ETA.
- Tom: share procurement timeline and any contract template or PO process.
- Redwood: we’ll prepare an onboarding calendar invite + ops checklist once SOW is signed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Marissa — that looks great and captures the discussion. A few quick notes: 

- We agree on the scope and the success metrics you listed; precision@10 >= 0.75 is a reasonable target to start with.
- Data ETA: Our infra team can deliver a zipped export of product docs + the last 6 months of tickets by Friday EOD (2027-05-21) — will deliver to the S3 bucket you provided in the access doc.
- Procurement: Tom will lead contracting and confirm our standard MSA addendum. We typically need a PO and security questionnaire completed before we can ship data. Tom — looping you for timing.

Security note: Our security team will send a SOC2 questionnaire and may ask for a short list of controls (encryption at rest, access logs). We’d like to keep the initial dataset scoped and anonymized where possible.

Confirming
- Kickoff call: happy to do onboarding sync next Monday (2027-05-24) at 10:00 AM PT if that works for your team.

Appreciate the clear plan — looking forward to working together.
